fusions.name: Hoofbeat Run
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles toward the target and hurl a stinger that deals 15 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Flung Clod
fusions.desc: A thrown clod that deals 8 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range. Holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds. A herd of stingers fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
